construction: Ordinary isotope-resolved binary radiative capture and distinct conditional 58Ni(p,gamma)59Cu(p,alpha)56Ni sequence; not correlated two-proton amplitude
original_blocks_read: Simon PDF p3 Table II and experimental text (extracted lines 175-246); all five stable Ni isotopes retained, with 61Ni outside commissioned even-isotope quartet
Lopez-Saavedra v2 PDF p2 Table I, finite strip intervals and 95% upper-limit construction; PDF p3 ground-state entrance qualification
ni_h_nuclear_ledger.py mass, decay and reaction interfaces; original NUBASE ground-state 59Cu,59Ni,59Co,56Ni,56Co,56Fe rows
data_policy: Preserve every source decimal and parentheses uncertainty, including 62Ni 2.90 MeV 1.379(17) mb exactly as printed
No interpolation, extrapolation, S factor, thermal reactivity or replacement of upper limits by detections
Measured rows may be used only with explicitly supplied response-matched proton fluxes and ground-state/state matching evidence; finite-bin effective cross sections are not pointwise functions
No automatic inference of MeV protons from lattice state
network_contract: Externally supplied time-independent row-matched fluxes for both encounters; explicit incoherent ground-state cascade preparation and competing-channel closure assumptions
Source-backed inclusive isotope decay topology; no invented beta+/EC split, excited-state branching or gamma spectra
Track capture events, alpha events and protons consumed separately; successful sequence consumes two protons, failed intermediate capture consumes one
Exact AME neutral-atom Q telescoping, separate weak-decay atomic endpoints, explicit electronic convention; no total-Q two-body partition for radiative sequence
Reaction radiation, recoil/particles, decay leptons, escape and deposition stay distinct; deposited heat unavailable without supplied transport model
oracles: Independent SymPy symbolic mass cancellation and exact original AME fields

Finite-network analytic competing-decay solution and conserved event balances; mutation checks for omitted decay, wrong pair/event multiplicity, unit/domain mistakes, mass mismatch and Q-to-heat assignment
missing_inputs: Ni+2p antisymmetrized channel-resolved transition amplitude or justified material reduction to sequential binary dynamics
Ni intrinsic spin-momentum receiver matrix elements, widths and state/phase conventions
Actual isotope/state preparation and two distinct proton encounter distributions in the Ni/H material
Intermediate stopping, cascade/state population, competing reactions and transport/deposition including neutrino/photon escape

implementation_receipt.scientific_execution_by_worker: None; Root executes consumer and oracle after integration. Original-source extraction, rendering, hashing and requested AME parser record inspection only.
implementation_receipt.data: sources/ni-measured-channels-original/measured-tables.json; 51 capture rows across five stable Ni isotopes and 8 Cu59(p,alpha) rows, including 2 upper limits
implementation_receipt.printed_q_discrepancy: Original rendered Simon PDF p3 Table I visibly prints Ni58 Q=3.814 MeV; extraction agrees. Existing AME parser independently inspected Ni58/H1/Cu59 original mass-excess rows. Preserve printed value, use evaluated masses for accounting; see capture-q-source-inspection.json.

optional_conditional_input.first_encounter_and_second_encounter: Each contains components[], entrance_state='laboratory-ground-state-unpolarized', state_matching_justification, response_matching_justification and provenance. Components contain row_id, energy_cm_mev, support_lower_mev, support_upper_mev, flux, energy_unit='MeV_CM', flux_unit='cm^-2 s^-1'. All numerical fields are exact decimal/rational strings; Simon support bounds are null because Table II supplies none; Cu bounds exactly match the published strip.
optional_conditional_input.initial_population: Explicit decimal-string counts for Ni58, Cu59, Ni59, Co59, Ni56, Co56, Fe56
optional_conditional_input.duration_s: Explicit finite nonnegative decimal-string duration; time-independent externally supplied proton flux reservoirs
optional_conditional_input.meaning: Model declarations are conditional assumptions requiring independent physical evidence, not proof of response/state matching. No supplied input means no computed rate/evolution.
